get.summary: Searches prompts and bundles using hybrid logic.
get.description:
Short queries (≤3 words or ≤30 chars) use fast database full-text search on name, description and tags.
Longer descriptive queries are sent to Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o) for semantic search.
Falls back to simple search if AI is unavailable.

parameters.description: Search query — can be a keyword (e.g. "UI") or a full sentence (e.g. "I want a prompt to refactor React components").
